name: Amorphic Labs
long_description: We build agents that create personalized product demo videos for tailored outbound, qualifying inbound, and call follow ups. Provide a list of prospects and our agent will research each prospect, use your app to record a tailored demo workflow complete with personalized seeded data, edit and narrate the video, then output a polished demo video ready to send.
one_liner: Agentic, Personalized Product Demo Videos for Sales
